Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 9
, Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer clicked into a broad NYC-wide directory page (dojos.info/NewYork/NewYork) instead of results specifically near the NYSE, ignoring the five-minute-walk constraint. This derailed the search, led to ad-laden pages, and no verification of walking distance or 7–9 pm schedules. The later “final answer” pulled names from that irrelevant list, producing locations far from the NYSE without time validation.
